utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Thanks, Uli — I really appreciate it. I’ll point you to the pile and we can get this repair drive moving along.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Sure, Tess. I’ll sort through the pile and set aside anything that still works.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Perfect — and just a quick heads-up, the repair drive’s moved to Sunday at the community center now. I’ll show you the pile there.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Sure — I’ll help sort the donations table and keep an eye on the tool sign-out sheet this Saturday at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Thanks, Mara — I missed the exact spot, so I’ll just look for you at the community center Saturday afternoon by the donations table.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Perfect — I’ll be by the donations table at the community center Saturday afternoon. See you then, Noah.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: I’ll grab a hammer and a screwdriver set if I can, and I’ll toss in any extra tape or zip ties I find.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Thanks, Bo — that covers the big stuff. If you spot anything else missing, just let me know and I’ll keep the list updated.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Yep, I’ll keep an eye out and send you anything else I find.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I’ll check with them right now and confirm what’s actually coming. I’ll let you know as soon as I hear back so we’re not short.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Good — you’re sure they’ll confirm it today, right?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Yes — I’m checking now and I’ll confirm today as soon as I hear back.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Check the church hall at 10 a.m. first — that’s where the repair drive is starting.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Sounds good — I’ll check in with the other groups and meet you at the church hall at 10. If anything comes up, I’ll send you a note.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Great — I’ll see you there at 10 a.m. at the church hall.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Just checking — it’s still on for today, right?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Yep, still on for today. See you there.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Great, just wanted to make sure. See you at the usual time.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I can be there after drop-off and we can start with the donation bins first. If 3:30 still works, I’ll head over then.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: 3:30 still works for me — I’ll have the screwdriver set, flashlight, and a small wrench ready. We can start with the donation bins first.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Perfect, I’ll head over at 3:30 after drop-off and we can start with the donation bins first.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Yep, still on for today. I’ll start with the hall faucet and then help with the washer.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Perfect—thanks, Leo. I’ll keep the next repair lined up while you check the faucet and washer.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Sounds good—I’ll handle the faucet first, then we can check the washer.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sounds good, Tess — I’ll look for the updated list and be ready to help Sunday at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Perfect, Sam — thanks! I’ll get the updated list to you, and we’ll meet Sunday at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Thanks, Tess — I’ll keep an eye out for the list and be ready Sunday at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Vik — that helps. I’ll wait for the transport details so I can plan the timing properly.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Absolutely — I’ll confirm the exact pickup time and who’s driving, and I’ll map out the transport so it’s all settled for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Vik — that sounds good. I’ll keep an eye out for the pickup time and driver details so I can plan around it.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Yeah, I’m on it — I’ll check the timing and sort out transport so the drive runs smoothly. Just nudge me if I go blank again.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Oren — that’s a big help. Just let me know as soon as you’ve got the timing and transport sorted.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Absolutely — I’ll get that to you as soon as I’ve confirmed it. And if I blank, just give me a nudge.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Will do — I’ll keep spreading the word and make sure everyone knows when to show up for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, Vik — I’m just going by the updates I’ve heard, so that helps a lot. I’ll pass it along if anyone asks.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Of course — I’ll keep folks in the loop if anything changes for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Hey Eli, I’m on my way now and I’ll meet you by the garage in ten minutes.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Sounds good, Dane. I’ll be by the garage and keep the plan steady for when you get here.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Great, I’m almost there now—thanks for holding the plan steady by the garage.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: That’s a good plan, Faye. I’ll be there tomorrow at 3:30, and we’ll sort the donations first.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Great, that works for me too. We’ll start with the donations, then make the parts list and assign the pickup and repair jobs.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Sounds good, Faye. I’ll bring the list, and we can keep to the plan tomorrow at 3:30.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: You got it, Hana — I’ll bring the tools by and we’ll make the repair drive a success.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Gus — that sounds perfect. See you at the repair drive!

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: You bet, Hana — I’ll see you there with the tools.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, Bo — I’ll keep an ear out for any updates on the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sure—nothing big yet, just steady support. I’ll let you know if anything changes.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, Bo — I appreciate you keeping me posted. I’ll pass along anything I hear, too.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: I’ll check the church hall at 10 a.m. first.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Great, I’ll start there too and see if anything else is still missing.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Perfect — I’ll meet you at the church hall at 10 a.m. and check what’s still missing.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, right — by the community center, north lot near the blue mailbox. Thanks for checking; I would've missed that.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Glad I could help — the north lot by the blue mailbox is easy to miss.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Yeah, that’s exactly the kind of spot I’d walk past without noticing. I’ll head there now — thanks again!

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Great, thanks Dane — those screwdrivers and gloves would really help. I’ll keep a spot open for you when you get here.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Thanks, Cleo — I’m on my way and I’ll help with the screwdrivers and gloves as soon as I get there.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Perfect, Dane — I’ve got a spot ready for you, and those extra tools will be a big help when you arrive.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Perfect — Sunday at the community center it is, and I’ll have you down for after 3 in the parking lot on Maple.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Sounds good — I’ll meet you in the parking lot on Maple after 3.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Great, thanks Rey — I’ll see you there after 3 on Maple.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Got it, Rosa — I’ll bring my notes to the community center on Sunday and we’ll sort the repairs together.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Perfect, Rey — thank you. I’ll be at the community center Sunday, and we’ll go through your notes together and make a priority list.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Sounds good, Rosa — I’ll see you at the community center Sunday with my notes.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Thanks — the community center parking lot on Maple after 3 works for me. If you have the exact spot on the notice, send it along and keep my name down too.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Perfect — I’ll keep your name down and pass along the exact spot from the notice as soon as I get it.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Thanks, Quinn — I appreciate it. I’ll watch for the exact spot on the notice.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I can take a look at the back gate hinge first. Bring the bikes and appliances by when you can, and I’ll see what’s still worth fixing.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Great, I’ll bring the bikes and appliances by later. Do you want me to leave them at the back gate?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Yes, please leave them by the back gate. I’ll check the hinge first and then sort through the rest when you bring them over.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Rey — could you help with the volunteer list and check in on anyone who’s already signed up?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Absolutely, Rosa — I’ll check who’s signed up and help with the volunteer list.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Sam — that’s a huge help. If you spot any gaps, let me know and I’ll fill them in before Sunday at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Great—just bring the bikes and small appliances, and we’ll sort the usable ones together.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Yep, I’ll bring the bikes and the small appliances and try to keep them in the right pile before Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Perfect—thanks, Oren. See you Saturday, and we’ll sort through them together.
